content.overview: BNS s. 354 — Act caused by inducing person to believe that he will be rendered an object of Divine displeasure.
content.study:
Introduction and meaning
Act caused by inducing person to believe that he will be rendered an object of Divine displeasure. BNS restatement of IPC 508. Elements are substantially the same; cite the BNS number for offences on or after 1 July 2024. BNS restatement of IPC 508. Cite the BNS number for facts on or after 1 July 2024.
In student language: BNS s. 354 is the rule on “Act caused by inducing person to believe that he will be rendered an object of Divine displeasure”. The section provides that . Whoever voluntarily causes or attempts to cause any person to do anything which that person is not legally bound to do, or to omit to do anything which he is legally entitled to do, by inducing or attempting to induce that person to believe that he or any person in whom he is interested will become or will be rendered by some act of the offender an object of Divine displeasure if he does not do the thing which it is the object of the offender to cause him to do, or if he does the thing which it is the object of the offender to cause him to omit, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to one year, or with fine, or with both. Do not stop at the heading. An examiner awards marks for the ingredients, the explanations and the illustrations, not for writing the title alone.

Why this is asked
Criminal law arguments turn on statutory ingredients. BNS s. 354 exists so that “Act caused by inducing person to believe that he will be rendered an object of Divine displeasure” has a closed legal test in Chapter XIX — Of Criminal Intimidation, Insult, Annoyance, Defamation, etc.. An authoritative analysis defines the concept, lists every ingredient, walks the statutory illustrations, states exceptions, and applies the test methodically to facts.
Chapter setting: Threats, insult, public mischief, drunken misconduct, defamation.

The provision in detail
354.. Whoever voluntarily causes or attempts to cause any person to do anything which that person is not legally bound to do, or to omit to do anything which he is legally entitled to do, by inducing or attempting to induce that person to believe that he or any person in whom he is interested will become or will be rendered by some act of the offender an object of Divine displeasure if he does not do the thing which it is the object of the offender to cause him to do, or if he does the thing which it is the object of the offender to cause him to omit, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to one year, or with fine, or with both

Essential ingredients
1. . Whoever voluntarily causes or attempts to cause any person to do anything which that person is not legally bound to do, or to omit to do anything which he is legally entitled to do, by inducing or attempting to induce that person to believe that he or any person in whom he is interested will become or will be rendered by some act of the offender an object of Divine displeasure if he does not do the thing which it is the object of the offender to cause him to do, or if he does the thing which it is the object of the offender to cause him to omit, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to one year, or with fine, or with both

Statutory illustrations
Illustration (a). A sits dharna at Z’s door with the intention of causing it to be believed that, by so sitting, he renders Z an object of Divine displeasure. A has committed the offence defined in this section

Exam use: quote illustration (a), then write which ingredient of BNS s. 354 it proves. Copying the illustration without that mapping sentence does not score.

Illustration (b). A threatens Z that, unless Z performs a certain act, A will kill one of A’s own children, under such circumstances that the killing would be believed to render Z an object of Divine displeasure. A has committed the offence defined in this section

Exam use: quote illustration (b), then write which ingredient of BNS s. 354 it proves. Copying the illustration without that mapping sentence does not score.
